variable {α : Type*} [LE α] {a : α}

@[to_dual (attr := simp)] lemma not_isLeast_empty : ¬ IsLeast ∅ a := by simp [IsLeast]

sources_consulted: /opt/formal-conjectures/.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Order/Bounds/Basic.lean — IsLeast.nonempty, empty-set bounds, and dual lemmas
review.notes:
The file introduces no definitions. Reviewed its sole explicit lemma, not_isLeast_empty, and its generated dual, not_isGreatest_empty. Both correctly assert that the empty set has no least/greatest element: Mathlib requires membership as well as the appropriate bound. The weak [LE α] assumption is sufficient; no order laws or inhabitedness assumption are needed. Searches found no direct references to either lemma in problem or library files and no duplicate empty-extremum lemma in Mathlib.

/workspace/review/scratch.lean and /workspace/review/finite_eval.lean both compiled successfully. Checks covered the elaborated statements, membership-and-bound characterizations, empty ambient types, singleton orders, zero, order duals, and the distinction between an empty set having a least upper bound and having a least element. Both lemma proofs depend only on propext, not sorryAx. No repository files were modified.
